restore.warning: This restores every writable data block and sector trailer, verifying each block. UID is not changed by default.
restore.uid_help: The dump's 4-byte UID is used by default and can be changed; keys and card capability are checked next.
uid.warning: Only for CUID/Gen2 cards that can change block 0 using an ordinary write command. NCC retains manufacturer data, calculates BCC, and backs up block 0 before writing.
recovery.warning: NCC first scans prior and common keys. Without a seed key, it uses Darkside as needed, then Nested. If sectors remain unresolved, it uses Hardnested, then verifies reads sector by sector. Darkside can run for up to one hour and Hardnested for up to six hours. Keep the card and reader in place. Use only on cards you own or are authorized to test.

migration.title: Safe card migration
migration.intro: Read the source card with keys you already control, then use the safety preflight to write a compatible physical card. The source card is not modified.
migration.step_source: Place the source card and choose Read source; its keys must already be in the key catalog.
migration.step_target: After a successful read, remove the source card and place a compatible blank card.
migration.step_verify: Run the write preflight, confirm the warnings, then write and verify block by block.
migration.warning: Use only cards and systems you own or are authorized to test. This wizard does not recover unknown keys; a phone wallet is not a writable MIFARE Classic blank card.
migration.ready_source: Place and read the source card.
migration.ready_target: Source read complete; replace it with the target card.
migration.reading: Reading the source card; keep it still.
migration.need_source: Read the source card first and confirm the dump is complete.
